title: Bazel HttpBlobStore.put hangs occasionally

labels.name: P1
labels.description: I'll work on this now. (Assignee required)

body:
I'm sure we're tracking this issue already, but I couldn't find it when I just looked for it.

We had [another hanging job](https://buildkite.com/bazel/bazel-bazel/builds/1205#495aa6ee-c535-446c-aa4f-9a513977c597) on CI on macOS that hit a new record - "Running for 3d 13h".
